message:
fix(lk-ux-retry r4): the retry's one deadline also bounds its reads, and is checked where the challenge is adopted

Codex SOURCE re-check on 9ff6c15 (codex_lk_ux_retry_src_r3.md), the two places left:

(1) a retry's Exchange waits -- write and read -- only until min(now + its relative budget, the retry's absolute
end); a write started just before the end no longer waits out the budget worked out before it.
(2) whether a retry's fresh challenge is adopted (held, cached as issued) is decided in the one critical section
that holds/caches it, with ownership AND the absolute end checked together (the separate preliminary check is
gone; the test hook sits right before that section).

Tests: relay ondemand 84/84 x4 (+ (8): a write held until just before the end, the service answering 900 ms
late -> 17 at 1746 ms, inside the caller's wait). Mutants: no clamp -> (8) FAIL (no answer, 2004 ms); adoption
without the deadline -> (7) FAIL (a late 'issued' adopted and held).
